title: cynoglossum alpinum
intro: Cynoglossum alpinum, commonly known as Alpine Hound's Tongue, is a flowering plant belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is used for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as its potential to alleviate respiratory issues like asthma and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Cynoglossum alpinum include its ability to relax muscles, reduce stress, and improve sleep quality, making it a popular choice for herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
